;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in Germany]]
**[[Germany|German]] police find guns and ammunition in a raid on suspected [[islamic extremism|Islamist militants]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-security-raids/german-police-find-guns-ammunition-in-raid-of-suspected-islamist-militant-idUSKBN1CU0W3?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Terrorism in Indonesia]]
**[[Indonesia]] arrests nine with alleged [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] links. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-security/indonesia-arrests-nine-with-alleged-islamic-state-links-idUSKBN1CU0BH?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Six crew from a [[Germany|German]] ship are kidnapped in [[Nigeria]]n waters. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-kidnapping/six-crew-from-german-ship-kidnapped-in-nigerian-waters-idUSKBN1CT1OZ?il=0 (Reuters)]
;Business and economy
*[[Economy of the European Union]]
**The [[European Commission]] scraps the draft legislation that would have permitted the [[European Banking Authority|EBA regulator]] to order "[[too big to fail]]" banks to split off their [[Trader (finance)|trading activities]], citing "no foreseeable agreement" in sight on criteria. The draft was supposed to be the [[European Union|EU]]'s answer to the [[United States]]' [[Volcker Rule]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-banks-regulations/eu-scraps-its-answer-to-u-s-volcker-rule-for-banks-idUSKBN1CT285?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Banking in the United States]]
**[[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] casts the tie-breaking vote late Tuesday night to repeal a rule that would have made it easier for Americans to sue their banks and credit card companies. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/24/politics/senate-cfpb-arbitration-repeal/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Immigration policy of the first Donald Trump administration|Immigration policy of Donald Trump]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[List of executive actions by Donald Trump|executive order]] which allows U.S. to resume its refugee program, with a 90-day review period for 11 countries identified as "high risk". [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/oct/24/trump-refugee-ban-end-immigration-executive-order (''The Guardian'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Ransomware]]
**Security researchers report on the outbreak of the ransomware nicknamed [[Bad Rabbit]], which has affected computer networks throughout the world, with [[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] being the worst affected. [http://www.ibtimes.com/what-bad-rabbit-petya-style-ransomware-attack-hits-russia-ukraine-2605724 (''International Business Times'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-41740768 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China]]
**The week-long [[Communist Party of China|Communist Party]] congress in [[Beijing]] draws to an end, with [[General Secretary of the Communist Party of China|General Secretary]] [[Xi Jinping]] set to become its most influential [[Paramount leader (China)|leader]] since [[Chairman of the Communist Party of China|Party Chairman]] [[Mao Zedong]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-41730948 (BBC)]
*[[United States Senate elections, 2018]]
**[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[United States Senator|Senator]] [[Jeff Flake]], a vocal critic of the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] from [[Arizona]] announces that he will not [[United States Senate election in Arizona, 2018|run again in 2018]]. [http://www.politico.com/story/2017/10/24/flake-retiring-after-2018-244114 (''Politico'')]
*[[Nuclear power in the United States]]
**Republican leaders in the [[U.S. House of Representatives]] launch an investigation into the [[Obama administration]]'s decision in 2010 to allow [[Rosatom]] to purchase Canada-based [[Uranium One]]. [http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-nunes-uranium-20171024-story.html (''Los Angeles Times'')]
